---
title: "Impact of TB Epidemic on Worker and Firm Productivity: Regional Perspective from Ukraine"
description: "GLO Discussion Paper 1360, 2023. With Olena Nizalova."
date: "2023-01-01"
status: "wip"
categories: [ukraine, firms]
---

Tuberculosis remains a significant regional health burden in Ukraine, with
prevalence varying sharply across oblasts. We link regional TB incidence
to worker- and firm-level productivity outcomes, asking how much of
Ukraine's regional productivity gap this specific health channel can
account for — evidence with direct relevance to postwar health and labour
policy.

**Working paper:** GLO Discussion Paper Series 1360
